minutes.headline: PACC agreed to have a detailed budget drafted using reserve funds for capital, and holds a special budget meeting Jan 20.
minutes.summary: The Public Access Cable Committee approved two sets of December minutes as amended, heard the manager's report, and discussed a rough FY26 budget that will lean on reserves for capital expenses. Most of the remaining discussion covered studio space ahead of a Select Board appearance, the stalled Master Plan Steering Committee, and a possible new town manager.

attendees.role: member (appears to be chair/presenter of the budget)

public_comment.topic: Chair asked for public comments; none were offered.

votes.motion: Accept the Dec 2 regular meeting minutes as amended
Accept the Dec 9 special meeting minutes as amended
Allow Steve and Joe to create a detailed budget for approval by the PACC committee

budget_items.what_was_said: Manager reported the balance and that November Comcast revenue was posted late; Comcast revenue continues to trend down.
The manager said ARPA spending is finished.
Program analysis was slow but local programming percentage was reported.
Fees have declined in recent months, with November drops in two years; cause unknown.
A rough guideline estimate for FY26 Comcast fees was given and described as not a real number.
Operating budget typically held below income with a typical capital allotment; proposal to use reserve funds for budgeted capital for the new studio.
Capital funds would normally be held for emergency replacement of the Castus server.
High-level numbers exclude investment income and any proposed state tax on streaming income.
Update on Enterprise fund investments as of Dec 31 was requested but no response was received.

decisions.decision: Special meeting on the budget, single agenda item, to be held Monday January 20 at the same time; Steve to try to reserve the room.
Chair to follow up with town hall on the studio policy review awaiting the town attorney.
Steve and Joe to attend the Select Board meeting the next night about studio space; another member may join.
Next regular meeting set for February 3.

what_happened.line: The committee voted unanimously to have a detailed budget drafted for its approval, using reserve funds for capital expenses.
A special meeting on the budget, with a single agenda item, was set for Monday, January 20, at the same time as regular meetings.
The manager reported that Comcast revenue continues to trend down, and that November revenue was posted late.
Two members were to attend the Select Board meeting the next night about studio space; the chair is to follow up on the studio policy awaiting the town attorney.
The next regular meeting was set for February 3.

why_it_matters: Cable access is paid for mainly by Comcast fees, and the minutes record those fees falling with no cause given, so the committee is planning to draw on reserves rather than income for capital items such as the new studio.
The January 20 special meeting and the studio-space discussion with the Select Board are where residents can see how that reserve money would be used.
